sources.title: Macroscopic scattering of cracks initiated at single impurity atoms
sources.authors: J. R. Kermode, L. Ben-Bashat, F. Atrash, J. J. Cilliers, D. Sherman, A. De Vita
sources.access: publisher full article indexed by search; direct open encountered publisher identity redirect
sources.method: QM/MM crack dynamics and three-point bending of B-doped Si on {111}
sources.supported_statement: Individual B impurities can induce position- and velocity-dependent crack-tip reconstruction and deflection; concentration affects observed ridge patterns.
sources.scope: Different concentrations, relaxed moving crack and specimen geometry from v10. No trajectory replay, fitted rate or validation of the v10 rigid path.

sources.title: Understanding Ultrahigh Doping: The Case of Boron in Silicon
sources.authors: Xuan Luo, S. B. Zhang, Su-Huai Wei
sources.access: publisher abstract only; numerical activation curve not acquired
sources.method: first-principles theory of ultrahigh B doping
sources.supported_statement: The authors attribute partial ionization in their high-concentration comparison primarily to electron chemical potential.
sources.scope: Chemical B concentration cannot be assigned to free hole density by a universal one-to-one rule; no activation fraction fitted here.

sources.title: Electronic strengthening mechanism of covalent Si via excess electron/hole doping
sources.authors: Hiroki Noda, Shumpei Sakaguchi, Ryoga Fujita, Susumu Minami, Hiroyuki Hirakata, Takahiro Shimada
sources.access: primary full article; supplementary values previously transcribed in v7
sources.method: published static DFT with excess electrons or holes and compensating background, no chemical dopant atoms
sources.scope: carrier-dependent homogeneous ideal strength; not this neutral chemical-substitution cleavage model and not wafer failure

sources.title: Engineering cleavage fracture of silicon via excess charge doping
sources.authors: Tao Xu, Shodai Nakai, Yasuaki Maruyama, Hiroki Noda, Susumu Minami, Hiroyuki Hirakata, Takahiro Shimada
sources.access: publisher abstract and introduction indexed by search; direct open returned 403; full article and numerical source data not acquired
sources.method: first-principles excess-carrier calculations with localized Alias deformation
sources.supported_statement: The abstract reports electron-induced reduction and hole-induced increase of cleavage strength and toughness, with carrier-dependent reconstruction.
sources.scope: evidence that explicit charge-dependent localized cleavage is required; no numerical fit or new DFT in this task

sources.title: Improved bending fatigue life of single crystal silicon micro-beam by phosphorus doping
sources.authors: Jun-Yong Tao, Xiao-Jing Wang, Bin Liu, Yan-Lei Wang, Zhi-Qian Ren, Xun Chen
sources.access: publisher abstract/highlights; full numerical concentration/life dataset not acquired
sources.method: room-temperature bending fatigue of P-doped single-crystal Si micro-beams
sources.supported_statement: The study reports fatigue life increasing with P concentration in its tested groups.
sources.scope: no universal strength multiplier, fitted lifetime or endurance-limit assertion
